updates.rationale: The finite-mesh foundations are accessible through standard finite-dimensional convex-hull methods, but without access researchers must independently formulate, check, and integrate the reduction into the converse program.

Independent agenda formation must still identify finite receiver compression, the midpoint barrier, and the exact three-site test as useful intermediate targets; their conventional finite-dimensional character makes this more directed than wholly open-ended exploration.
Absent access, a researcher must independently derive and audit the finite-mesh receiver representation and its mirror-preserving specialization before these foundations become usable.

The realized foundations show that a productive finite-grid route is discoverable with standard convex and computational techniques, while substantial search remains because the actors receive neither the route nor its supporting derivations.
